The hit video game "Cyberpunk 2077" is being made into a movie! As reported by Deadline magazine, Paramount Pictures is planning a live-action adaptation of the action role-playing game of the same name by CD Projekt Red. Paramount has secured an experienced Hollywood producer for the project. Lorenzo di Bonaventura, who has previously worked on the "Transformers" franchise, among other projects, will oversee the project.
